## What's changed

- Reorganizes Library Optimization into focused Setup, Plan & Activity, and History tabs for a cleaner workflow.
- Adds a persistent, searchable per-file history showing successful, skipped, and failed media across optimizer runs and server updates.
- Shows original and optimized sizes, codec changes, per-file savings, timestamps, and clear failure or skip details, with status filters and pagination for large libraries.
- Adds a persistent total-space-saved summary based only on successful replacements, while keeping current-run savings clearly separated in the activity view.
- Corrects optimizer accounting so rejected or skipped outputs no longer inflate reported storage savings.
- Simplifies unavailable encoder results to a clean Unavailable state instead of displaying lengthy FFmpeg probe output in the capability list.

Library Optimization remains optional and server-managed; existing players do not require an update.
